description.value: Fresh Solo Pasta is a Vancouver Italian restaurant focused on hand-made fettuccine and artisanal pasta crafted daily from organic, non-GMO semolina and farm-to-table herbs. The restaurant leans heavily into plant-based dining, offering a full range of vegan Italian options and halal-sourced pasta dishes. It operates three Vancouver locations — on Granville St, Denman St, and Sasamat St — and offers online ordering with delivery.
